name: Weather FX
description: Dynamic weather for overworld and battles — Weather FX owns AUTO/fronts, typed residuals, buffs/nerfs, seasons, day/night, celestial systems, audio, and 2D/3D atmosphere. WX Pokémon variants are now supplied by the separate Weather FX - WX Pokémon add-on.
credits: Battle backdrops: CDRX73, DerxwnaKapsyla, http404error, Game Freak. Rain/storm loops: Relic Castle weather tutorial pack. Thunder and wind: Pixabay (royalty-free). 3D atmosphere integration adapted from Kanto Dynamic Weather by Campo (1-Camp0-1).
baselineNote: 8.2.14 removes the former RAVE weather mode from Weather FX. The manual weather catalogue entry, RAVE settings, music ownership, 3D rave cloud/laser/fog/floor rendering, battle carryover, RaveMusic runtime module, and bundled rave soundtrack assets are removed. All ordinary weather, Gen1/Gen2 support, 2D/3D rendering, snow, clouds, lightning, tornadoes, water, seasons, audio, battles, and performance systems remain.
